items.title: Memphis-Temple Set for 2:30 p.m. Kickoff on Black Friday
items.summary: IRVING, Texas – The American Conference has announced its television designations for Nov. 27, with Memphis set to kick off its regular season finale against Temple at 2:30 p.m. in Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium.

items.title: Stokes Named to Davey O’Brien Award Great 8 for Fourth Time in 2026
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – For the fourth time this season and third game in a row, University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes were named to the Davey O'Brien Award Great 8, the Davey O'Brien Foundation announced on Monday.

items.title: Montgomery, Stokes Collect American Weekly Honorable Mentions
items.summary: IRVING, Texas – University of Memphis linebacker Mike Montgomery and quarterback Marcus Stokes were named to the American's list of weekly award honorable mentions, the conference announced Monday morning.

items.title: Memphis-Navy to Air on ESPN2
items.summary: IRVING, Texas – The University of Memphis football team's matchup on Saturday, Nov. 21 at Navy will air on ESPN2, the American confirmed Sunday morning.

items.summary: The Memphis Tigers improve to 8-2 with the 52-41 win over USF. Let’s look at Pro Football Focus (PFF) to see the Memphis grades

items.title: Winners and losers: Memphis offense puts up 52, defense struggles in thrilling win
items.summary: The Tigers went up 21-0 in the first quarter, but a long field goal miss swung the momentum, and USF dominated Memphis' defense from that point on. Luckily for Memphis, the offense kept up, and the defense made a couple of timely stops at the end to escape with the win.

items.title: Tigers Outlast South Florida, 52-41, in High-Scoring Thursday Night Matchup
items.summary: TAMPA, Fla. – The University of Memphis (8-2, 5-1 American) football team came up big when needed to secure a 52-41 win over South Florida (6-4, 2-4 American) in a Thursday night shootout inside Raymond James Stadium.

items.summary: TAMPA, Fla. – The University of Memphis (7-2, 4-1 American) football team travels South Florida (6-3, 2-3 American) for the Tigers' second Thursday night matchup of the season, inside Raymond James Stadium.

items.title: Stokes Named to Davey O’Brien QB Class of 2026
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes has been announced as a member of the Davey O'Brien QB Class of 2026, a group of 30 players that puts Stokes in contention for the 2026 Davey O'Brien National Quarterback Award.

items.title: 2028 safety Markel Long on Memphis offer: 'I can definitely see myself playing under Coach Huff'
items.summary: 2028 Safety Markel Long picked up an offer from the Memphis Tigers recently and he spoke to TSR to give us his thoughts about the program.

items.title: Stokes Named Davey O’Brien National Quarterback of the Week
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes picked up another accolade, being named the Davey O'Brien National Quarterback of the Week after accounting for five touchdowns in Memphis' 49-22 win over Army.

items.title: Tuck Named to Ray Guy Award’s Week Nine “Ray’s 8”
items.summary: AUGUSTA, Ga. – University of Memphis punter Harrison Tuck was selected as one of the "Ray's 8" for week nine, the Augusta Sports Council and the Ray Guy Award committee announced on Monday.

items.title: Stokes Headlines Week Nine Manning Award Stars of the Week
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS – University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes was named to the Manning Award Stars of the Week, with the award committee announcing him as the highlighted player on the list on Monday.
